english.title: Assisting offender - either way offences only
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), with intent to impede the apprehension or prosecution of

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_
(B)_[a person]_

who had committed the offence of **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT EITHER WAY OFFENCE..), knowing or believing

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_
(E)_[the said person]_

to be guilty of the offence or some other relevant offence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) and (3) of the Criminal Law Act 1967.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/reasonable excuse did an act

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) See also offence wordings H2019 - for purely indictable offences and H2024 - for murder only.

other.powersofarrest:
arrest without warrant

IMPORTANT:
The powers of arrest for offences under section 4(1) require that the offences to which they relate must carry a sentenced fixed by law or one in which a first time offender aged 18 or over could be sentenced to 5 years or more imprisonment.
other.penalty:
Triable eitherway ONLY if the offence to which this offence relates is triable eitherway :

Seven years imprisonment if it is an offence for which a person (not previously convicted) may be sentenced to fourteen years imprisonment.

Five years imprisonment if it is an offence for which a person (not previously convicted) may be sentenced to ten years imprisonment.

Three years imprisonment in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
